exclusion_detail: The abstract names 16b (beta-thymine nucleoside-SAHA hybrid, n = 6). Its route needs at least 9 reactions: dithiane 5 from 4-chlorobenzaldehyde, Michael addition to TBS-butenolide 6, Pd-catalysed carbamate coupling (8), DIBAL-H reduction and acetylation (9), silyl Hilbert-Johnson thymine introduction (10), Boc removal (11b), BOPCl amide coupling (14-type ester), hydroxylamine conversion to 16b; the butenolide 6 is itself made from D-mannitol.

lead.label: 16b
lead.why: Among the synthesized hybrid compounds, compound 16b showed the potent HDAC inhibitory activity at a low nanomolar level and exhibited antiproliferative activity toward cancer cell lines.

notes: All final compounds 16-18 share the same long route (more than 4 steps), so no other compound in the paper qualifies.
